description: Presidential Secretariate - Appointed Ms. K. A. Rohanadeera, as the Secretary General of the Parliament with effect from 23.05.2023
categorisation: This gazette announces the appointment of a specific individual (Ms. K. A. Rohanadeera) to a government position (Secretary General of the Parliament). It names the person and provides the basic title of the appointment but does not include any detailed description of her portfolio responsibilities, duties, or subject areas she will oversee. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
